summary: Website/portfolio for light artist Istvan Seidel featuring his NFT collections on the TON Blockchain (Getgems). The project includes a Werkverzeichnis (catalogue of works) with linked NFT collections.
architectural_notes: NFT collections are hosted on TON Blockchain via Getgems (getgems.io). Links must not be changed.
Two Getgems accounts: main account (lichtei, wheeloftime, colourshades) and secondary account (Schieferlichtgrafik, light seekers, panel paintings, Flammenbilder fire dance)
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- Abstract glowing egg sculpture with radiant light beams and golden tones on a dark background, representing light art (nft-preview-lichtei.dim_600x400.png)
- Mystical spinning wheel constructed from luminous colored light trails against a deep cosmic background (nft-preview-wheeloftime.dim_600x400.png)
- Spectrum of vivid color gradients dissolving into each other like stained glass illuminated from within (nft-preview-colourshades.dim_600x400.png)
- Textured slate surface with engraved light patterns and glowing geometric lines etched into stone (nft-preview-schieferlichtgrafik.dim_600x400.png)
- Abstract human silhouettes reaching upward toward beams of ascending radiant light in a dark void (nft-preview-lightseekers.dim_600x400.png)
- Luminous rectangular panels arranged in a grid, each glowing with a different intense color of light (nft-preview-panelpaintings.dim_600x400.png)
- Dynamic swirling flames rendered in vivid orange, red, and gold light trails dancing against a black background (nft-preview-firedance.dim_600x400.png)

existing_features.title: Update NFTCollectionsSection.tsx to include all seven NFT collections with their exact Getgems URLs: Lichtei (https://getgems.io/lichtei), Wheel of Time (https://getgems.io/wheeloftime), Colour Shades (https://getgems.io/colourshades), Schieferlichtgrafik (https://getgems.io/collection/EQCgrHXOmAryUksLLtlh5dsXyT_h2DF6vLiEUiwsj05KFjJM), Light Seekers (https://getgems.io/collection/EQA1W-YI6IGmi_94KoIgwgD79i_bhz0Uot-Z1y5W8fBGuIAz), Panel Paintings (https://getgems.io/collection/EQA_bfpwKniQOAATWojdfIDk9X7_mCW_Stpzt_1kDSF6UDYV), and Flammenbilder Fire Dance (https://getgems.io/collection/EQA8b4VisUmrk2tiumRI-wmlM3QhahoGeGNqSYzrO6s9O2Vf).
